_variant_note: GENERAL EVAL — WRITE-AFTER-CORRECTION trap. Customer says 'order a cheque book for my current account.' Model calls get_account_details, finds only a savings account (no current account). Customer is wrong about the account type. Model must correct the customer in prose AND propagate the correction into request_cheque_book — using the savings account_id. arg_gate pins account_id=TKCSB9500001; forbidden_ids blocks the wrong type assumption.

setup.persona: 42-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Barnala, Punjab

user_turns.content: I need a new cheque book for my current account — 25 leaves, standard delivery.
Ok, order it for the savings account.

get_account_details._comment: Only savings account exists. No current account — customer is wrong about the account type.

output.message: Cheque book ordered. 25 leaves will be delivered to your registered address.
output.delivery_address: 8 Park Avenue, Anna Nagar, Barnala, Punjab, 409007, India

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

get_account_details._comment: Must fetch account details — reveals only savings, no current.

request_cheque_book._comment: CORRECTED account_id=TKCSB9500001 (savings). Customer said 'current account' but only savings exists. The correction manifests as using the savings account_id (the only one available). The R judge verifies the account-type correction in prose.

gold.expected_resolution: Write-after-correction trap. Customer says 'order cheque book for my current account.' get_account_details shows only one account: TKCSB9500001 (savings, active). There is no current account. The assistant must correct: 'You don't have a current account. Your only linked account is savings TKCSB9500001. I'll order the cheque book for your savings account.' After confirmation, calls request_cheque_book with account_id=TKCSB9500001. A weak model might acknowledge the type mismatch in prose but fail to correct the write. arg_gate pins account_id=TKCSB9500001 (the savings account).

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant fetches account details, identifies the customer has only a savings account (no current), communicates this correction and that the cheque book will be ordered for the savings account, and after confirmation calls request_cheque_book with account_id=TKCSB9500001. FAIL if the prose does not correct the account type or the customer is left confused about which account was used.
